description.value: The Houston & District Chamber of Commerce operates the Visitor Information Centre on Highway 16 in northwest BC, located right next to Canada's Largest Fly Rod. It serves as a useful stop for cyclists travelling between Prince George and Prince Rupert, offering local area information and a downloadable digital visitor guide covering accommodations, paddling, hiking, and fishing in the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Visitor Information Centre on Highway 16 in Houston, BC, with address 3289 Highway 16 and phone numbers listed. The site is clearly operational (2026 copyright, current job postings, seasonal hours). OSM tags indicate free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no, check_date 2023-07-29) which the website does not explicitly mention or contradict. No evidence on the website for bike parking, water refill, or washroom availability to visitors.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Visitor Information Centre on Highway 16 between Prince George and Prince Rupert — a natural and useful stop for touring cyclists needing local information, maps, and orientation in northwest BC.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM has no phone or address to cross-check; website provides both. Toll-free number also available: 1-877-217-7172. Wheelchair accessible per OSM tags.
